classes.name: Sentence
classes.description: A clause or sentence unit in the corpus containing tokens to be analyzed.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: A surface word form occurring in a sentence, potentially ambiguous between multiple analyses.

classes.name: CandidateAnalysis
classes.description: One possible morphological analysis of a token, consisting of a stem plus suffix tags.

classes.name: Lemma
classes.description: The dictionary/citation form (stem) underlying a candidate analysis.

classes.name: Stem
classes.description: The verbal or nominal stem to which morphological suffixes attach.

classes.name: Suffix
classes.description: A morphological suffix attached to a stem expressing grammatical features.

classes.name: PartOfSpeech
classes.description: A lexical category such as Verb, Noun, Postposition, Adverb, Conjunction, Particle, Pronoun, Numeral.

classes.name: Case
classes.description: A morphosyntactic category marking nominal grammatical role (NOM, GEN, DAT, ACC, ILL, LOC, EL, ABL, INS, ADV, PROL, DELIM).

classes.name: Number
classes.description: Grammatical number: singular or plural.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Grammatical person: 1, 2, 3, or polypersonal (1/2).

classes.name: Tense
classes.description: Grammatical tense: present, past, future.

classes.name: Mood
classes.description: Grammatical mood: indicative, imperative, debitive.

classes.name: Voice
classes.description: Grammatical voice: active, passive, causative.

classes.name: Aspect
classes.description: Grammatical aspect, e.g., iterative.

classes.name: Evidentiality
classes.description: Evidential category marking witness status of an event.

classes.name: PossessiveMarking
classes.description: Possessive suffix marking person/number of the possessor on a noun.

classes.name: NonFiniteForm
classes.description: Non-finite verbal forms such as infinitive, converb, participle, verbal noun.

classes.name: ClauseType
classes.description: Type of clause: declarative, interrogative, imperative, negative.

classes.name: MorphologicalTag
classes.description: A single tag symbol (e.g., PST, PRS.3SG, PASS, ACC) in the UniParser tagset.

classes.name: Genre
classes.description: Text genre (e.g., newspaper/press) affecting statistical preferences.

classes.name: SemanticRole
classes.description: Thematic role of an argument (agent, patient, theme, goal, etc.).

properties.name: belongsToSentence
properties.description: Links a token to the sentence it occurs in.

properties.name: candidateOf
properties.description: Links a candidate analysis to the token it analyzes.

properties.name: hasLemma
properties.description: Each candidate analysis is associated with a lemma.

properties.name: hasStem
properties.description: The stem component of a candidate analysis.

properties.name: hasSuffix
properties.description: A suffix that appears in a candidate analysis.

properties.name: hasTag
properties.description: A morphological tag belonging to a candidate analysis.

properties.name: hasForm
properties.description: Surface string form of the token.

properties.name: hasPosition
properties.description: Linear position of the token within the sentence.

properties.name: hasCandidatePOS
properties.description: Candidate part of speech assigned by an analysis.

properties.name: hasCandidateCase
properties.description: Candidate case feature in an analysis.

properties.name: hasCandidateNumber
properties.description: Candidate number feature in an analysis.

properties.name: hasCandidatePerson
properties.description: Candidate person feature in an analysis.

properties.name: hasCandidateTense
properties.description: Candidate tense in an analysis.

properties.name: hasCandidateMood
properties.description: Candidate mood feature.

properties.name: hasCandidateVoice
properties.description: Candidate voice feature (active, passive, causative).

properties.name: hasCandidateAspect
properties.description: Candidate aspect feature (e.g., iterative).

properties.name: hasCandidateEvidentiality
properties.description: Candidate evidential marking.

properties.name: hasCandidatePossessive
properties.description: Candidate possessive marking.

properties.name: hasNonFiniteForm
properties.description: Indicates a non-finite form type for the analysis.

properties.name: isFinite
properties.description: True if the analysis is a finite verb form.

properties.name: isNegated
properties.description: True if the analysis contains NEG marking.

properties.name: hasTagString
properties.description: Full tag string of the candidate analysis.

properties.name: hasSuffixForm
properties.description: Surface form of the suffix.

properties.name: hasLemmaForm
properties.description: Citation form of a lemma.

properties.name: isTransitive
properties.description: True if the lemma denotes a transitive verb.

properties.name: isIntransitive
properties.description: True if the lemma is inherently intransitive.

properties.name: isMotionVerb
properties.description: True if the lemma is a verb of motion.

properties.name: isModalOrControlVerb
properties.description: True if the lemma is a modal or control verb licensing infinitive complements.

properties.name: isAnimate
properties.description: True if the token's referent is animate.

properties.name: isInanimate
properties.description: True if the token's referent is inanimate.

properties.name: isVolitional
properties.description: True if the subject is a volitional agent.

properties.name: hasSubject
properties.description: Links a clause/sentence to its overt subject token.

properties.name: hasPredicate
properties.description: Links a clause/sentence to its predicate token.

properties.name: hasTokenPOS
properties.description: Resolved POS of a token.

properties.name: hasTokenCase
properties.description: Resolved case of a token.

properties.name: hasTokenNumber
properties.description: Resolved number of a token.

properties.name: hasTokenPerson
properties.description: Resolved person of a token.

properties.name: hasTokenTense
properties.description: Resolved tense of a token.

properties.name: governsCase
properties.description: A postposition or verb token governs a particular case on its complement.

properties.name: governedBy
properties.description: Links a complement token to its governor (postposition or verb).

properties.name: precedes
properties.description: Linear precedence between tokens in the sentence.

properties.name: modifies
properties.description: Indicates that the first token modifies the second.

properties.name: hasClauseType
properties.description: Type of the clause.

properties.name: hasGenre
properties.description: Genre context for a sentence.

properties.name: isClauseInitial
properties.description: True if the token is the first in its clause.

properties.name: isClauseFinal
properties.description: True if the token is clause-final.

properties.name: isMainPredicate
properties.description: True if the token functions as main predicate of its clause.

properties.name: inClause
properties.description: Token belongs to a given clause.

properties.name: coordinatedWith
properties.description: Indicates two predicates are coordinated.

properties.name: hasNegAuxiliary
properties.description: Links a clause to its negative auxiliary token.

properties.name: hasNegativeAuxiliary
properties.description: True if the clause contains a negative auxiliary.

properties.name: hasAuxiliary
properties.description: True if the clause contains an auxiliary verb.

properties.name: hasSemanticRole
properties.description: Thematic role assigned to a token.

properties.name: isInterrogativeClause
properties.description: True if the clause contains an interrogative pronoun or question particle.

properties.name: hasOvertThirdPersonSubject
properties.description: True if the clause has an overt 3rd-person nominal subject.

properties.name: hasFrequencyAdverb
properties.description: True if the clause contains a frequency adverb (уно, котькуд, пол).

properties.name: hasPresentTimeAdverbial
properties.description: True if the clause contains a present-time adverbial (e.g., туннэ).

properties.name: hasPossessor
properties.description: Links a possessed noun to its genitive-marked possessor.

properties.name: hasNoPossessor
properties.description: True if the token has no expressed possessor.

properties.name: isLexicalizedNoun
properties.description: True if a form historically derived from a verb is now a lexicalized noun.

properties.name: hasAmbiguityWith
properties.description: Marks two analyses as alternatives for the same token.

properties.name: endsInSuffix
properties.description: True if the token surface ends in a given suffix string.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidatePOS(A, pos) & hasCandidatePerson(A, p) & hasCandidateNumber(A, n) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & hasSubject(C, S) & hasTokenPerson(S, p) & hasTokenNumber(S, n)
rules.description: A verbal candidate analysis is agreement-compatible when its person and number features match those of the clause's subject.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidatePerson(A, p12) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & hasSubject(C, S) & hasTokenPerson(S, p3)
rules.description: A 1st/2nd person candidate is incompatible when the clause has an overt 3rd-person nominal subject.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidatePOS(A, pos) & governsCase(T, c) & precedes(N, T) & hasTokenCase(N, c)
rules.description: A postpositional analysis is compatible when a nominal preceding the token bears the case governed by the postposition.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateCase(A, acc) & governedBy(T, V) & hasTokenPOS(V, verb) & hasLemma(AV, L) & candidateOf(AV, V) & isTransitive(L)
rules.description: An accusative candidate analysis is compatible when its governing verb is transitive.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateCase(A, ill) & governedBy(T, V) & candidateOf(AV, V) & hasLemma(AV, L) & isMotionVerb(L)
rules.description: An illative candidate analysis is compatible when the governing verb is a motion verb.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & isNegated(A) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & hasNegativeAuxiliary(C)
rules.description: A negated verb form is licensed only when a negative auxiliary is present in the same clause.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasNonFiniteForm(A, ptcp) & hasCandidateVoice(A, active) & precedes(T, N) & modifies(T, N)
rules.description: An active participle analysis is preferred when the token immediately precedes and modifies a noun.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasNonFiniteForm(A, ptcp) & hasCandidateVoice(A, passive) & precedes(T, N) & modifies(T, N)
rules.description: A past passive participle (PTCP.PST) reading of -эм/-ем forms is preferred when the token modifies a following noun.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateEvidentiality(A, evid) & isClauseFinal(T) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & -hasAuxiliary(C)
rules.description: An evidential reading of -эм/-ем is preferred when the token is clause-final in a clause lacking an auxiliary.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasNonFiniteForm(A, inf) & precedes(V, T) & candidateOf(AV, V) & hasLemma(AV, L) & isModalOrControlVerb(L)
rules.description: An infinitive analysis is compatible when the token follows a modal or control verb.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasNonFiniteForm(A, cvb) & precedes(T, V) & isFinite(AV) & candidateOf(AV, V) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & belongsToSentence(V, C)
rules.description: A converb analysis is preferred when a finite verb follows the token within the same clause.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateVoice(A, passive) & hasLemma(A, L) & isIntransitive(L)
rules.description: A passive analysis is anomalous when the verb lemma is inherently intransitive.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateVoice(A, passive) & hasLemma(A, L) & isTransitive(L) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & hasSubject(C, S) & isInanimate(S)
rules.description: A passive analysis is compatible when the verb is transitive and the surface subject is inanimate.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidatePossessive(A, p3sg) & precedes(N, T) & hasTokenCase(N, gen)
rules.description: A P.3SG analysis of the -эз/-ез suffix is preferred when a genitive-marked possessor precedes the head noun.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateCase(A, acc) & governedBy(T, V) & candidateOf(AV, V) & hasLemma(AV, L) & isTransitive(L) & hasNoPossessor(T)
rules.description: An accusative reading is preferred when the noun is direct object of a transitive verb and has no possessor.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateMood(A, imp) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & hasOvertThirdPersonSubject(C)
rules.description: An imperative analysis is incompatible when the clause has an overt 3rd-person subject.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateAspect(A, iter) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & hasFrequencyAdverb(C)
rules.description: An iterative analysis is preferred when frequency adverbs are present in the clause.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateTense(A, prs) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & hasPresentTimeAdverbial(C)
rules.description: A present-tense analysis is supported when a present-time adverbial occurs in the clause.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidatePOS(A, adj) & precedes(T, N) & modifies(T, N)
rules.description: An attributive analysis of -о/-ё forms is preferred when the token modifies a following noun.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & belongsToSentence(T, C) & coordinatedWith(T, U) & precedes(U, T) & hasCandidateTense(A, x) & hasTokenTense(U, x) & hasCandidatePerson(A, y) & hasTokenPerson(U, y)
rules.description: In coordinated verbal predicates, a candidate is preferred when its tense and person match those of a preceding coordinated verb.

rules.fol_expression: candidateOf(A, T) & hasCandidateMood(A, deb) & isMainPredicate(T) & endsInSuffix(T, "ono")
rules.description: A debitive analysis is preferred when the -оно form functions as the main predicate of a clause.
